question: Which memory-wiki isolation contract should OpenClaw support for shared-gateway multi-agent setups?
rationale: The fix changes plugin config/API shape and durable memory isolation semantics, and automation cannot choose between plugin-owned vault routing, generic plugin overrides, or declaring the shared-gateway case unsupported.

options.title: Design plugin-owned vault isolation
options.body: Add a memory-wiki-owned per-agent or context-aware vault contract now, with explicit precedence and no-context behavior.

options.title: Wait for generic plugin overrides
options.body: Keep this blocked on #55401 so one generic agents.list[].plugins override system handles memory-wiki and other plugins together.

options.title: Document unsupported isolation
options.body: Close the product gap by stating that memory-wiki is not safe for shared-gateway per-agent vault isolation until a future contract exists.

recommendation.title: Design plugin-owned vault isolation
recommendation.body: Add a memory-wiki-owned per-agent or context-aware vault contract now, with explicit precedence and no-context behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses plugin config, memory isolation, and security posture, which needs the broad owner identified by CODEOWNERS rather than a narrow code-only change.
